Subject: Reserved capacity — pricing options and start windows

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking a look at Sparrow's RFP — attaching the PDF for context (Sparrow_RFP_Q3.pdf). We're evaluating a dedicated / reserved commit for inference (image + retrieval workload) and need to understand how Redwood structures pricing across 12/24/36 month terms, plus options for phasing the capacity up. A few clarifying questions from our procurement and infra teams: 

- For reserved commits, do you price on vGPU-equivalent units or by GPU SKU? Can we mix SKUs in a single commit?
- What are the standard discount bands for 12 / 24 / 36 month commitments (we're primarily interested in committed GPU-hours / reserved vGPU slots)?
- Do you provide onboarding / staging credits so we can validate performance at lower capacity before ramping? If so, how are credits applied and do they expire?
- We need a throughput guarantee for steady-state batch inference (target 50K tokens/s across cluster) and a P99 latency SLO for short-live requests — what SLAs/credits exist for missed targets?
- Earliest capacity start date: we need to understand lead time to reserve pools (do you have committed start windows).

Ben and I ran some initial sizing; we'll share numbers in a follow-up, but please include an example ramp schedule (e.g., Month 0–3 staging at 25% capacity, M4–6 60% etc.) and a simple price comparison for the three term lengths.

Goal: get a formal proposal we can take to procurement by mid-November. Can Redwood provide a draft commercial term sheet + an estimated PO amount?

Thanks — Sylvia

Hi Sylvia — great to see the RFP, thanks for sending. High level answers and an initial price matrix are attached (redwood-dedicated-pricing-v1.pdf) — summary below: 

1) Unit of commitment
- We bill reserved commits in "reserved vGPU-equivalents" (RVUs). Each model of GPU has an RVU factor (e.g., A100-80GB = 1.0, A100-40GB = 0.6, H100 = 1.2). Customers may mix SKUs in a commit; billing is normalized to RVUs.

2) Discount bands (illustrative)
- 12 months: base discount 12% off list for committed RVUs
- 24 months: base discount 20% off list + elasticity credits
- 36 months: base discount 27% off list + multi-year retention credit
- Additional commercial: early-signing incentive (time-limited + additional usage credits) and higher discounts for larger RVU tiers. Exact percentages are configurable by deal size — see attached band table.

3) Staging / onboarding credits
- We can provide a 90-day staging credit equal to up to 15% of the first three months' committed spend, applied as bill credit. Credits are non-refundable, expire after 120 days if not used, and do not apply to overage charges unless pre-approved.

4) Throughput & SLA
- For inference throughput guarantees we offer a "Throughput SLO" in the Dedicated contract: target sustained throughput (tokens/s) and latency P99 targets tied to specific model families and sequence lengths. Remedy for missed SLOs is service credit applied to monthly invoice; exact credit tied to severity and duration. We include a performance profile during onboarding.

5) Capacity start windows and ramp
- Typical lead time for reserving a Dedicated RVU pool is 6–10 weeks depending on region and SKU availability. We support phased ramps: M0–M2 staging (25%), M3–M5 ramp to 60%, M6 sustained at 100% (example). We can accelerate if there's available surplus capacity.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll loop Marissa (account exec) to put together a formal commercial proposal with options for 12/24/36 month terms and a recommended ramp schedule.
- If you can confirm target RVUs (rough range) we'll give a concrete PO-level estimate.

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the time over the last few weeks. Attached is Redwood's formal proposal (redwood-proposal-sparrow-20261129.pdf) which covers three commercial options (12/24/36 months), an explicit ramp schedule, the proposed onboarding credit, and the PO-level estimate. Key highlights: 

- Recommended: 24-month commit for 160 RVUs with a 3-phase ramp: M0–M2 30% staging, M3–M5 ramp to 65%, M6 onward 100%.
- Pricing: 24-month effective discount 22% off list (includes the early-sign incentive). 12-month option is 13% off, 36-month is 28% off with a retention credit applied in year 3.
- Credits & incentives: 90-day staging credit (up to 15% of M1–M3 committed spend) + an extra 8% onboarding credit if PO signed by 2026-11-20 (Ben flagged this cutoff). 
- SLA: We include a throughput SLO tied to the agreed model perf profile; service credits defined in Section 4 of the attached.
- Availability & start: estimated pool reservation lead time 8 weeks from signed PO; target onboarding kickoff 2027-01-05 (tentative).

Next actions:
1) Please confirm which term (12/24/36) Sparrow prefers and the target committed RVU range.
2) If acceptable, we'll prepare a standard commercial term sheet and DocuSign link (https://redwood.sign/SPR-202611/proposal) for signature.
3) Post-signing: coordinate onboarding dates and a capacity readiness call.

We tried to align the pricing and ramp to Sparrow's RFP ask — happy to jump on a 30-minute call to walk through the numbers if that helps.

Best regards,
